title: Custom Soccer Goal Splash Bedding Comforter Set, Machine Washable
description:
Inspire the young soccer enthusiast in your life with this custom comforter set, designed to bring the excitement of the game right into their room. This cozy bedding is perfect for any fan looking to celebrate their passion for soccer.

Key Features

  • Soccer Enthusiasm: Ideal for young soccer fans, inspiring dreams and excitement for the sport.
  • Personalized Design: Customize with a name and number, making it a unique gift for boys.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy to Use: Features a hidden zipper and smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Environmentally protective finishing ensures color retention and prevents fading, with smooth, fine, and compact stitching.
  • Included Components: This set includes one duvet cover.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and air dry without heat for simple maintenance.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Duvet Cover Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Pattern Soccer
Selected Design A4
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 1 text input
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Special Feature Hidden zipper
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 360
